cognitive_contract.label: Synthesize / cross-topic synthesis (Advanced Olympiad)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Integrate concepts across two or more distinct mathematical branches (Geometry + Number Theory, Algebra + Geometry, Combinatorics + Number Theory) to establish an integrated multi-stage solution that evaluates protected value W.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Require learner to bridge alien mathematical frameworks without step-by-step intermediate handoffs.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Activate the individual domain identities without providing the bridge connecting them.

slots.X: synthesizing geometric inradius formulation with Diophantine divisor pairing on integer right triangles
slots.Y: right-angled triangle with integer side lengths, Area = 3 * Perimeter
slots.Z: synthesis invariant: Area = r * s = 3 * (2s) -> inradius r = 6; right triangle inradius r = (a + b - c)/2 = 6 induces Diophantine relation (a - 12)(b - 12) = 72; minimum perimeter at factor pair (8, 9) -> a = 20, b = 21, c = 29 -> P = 70
slots.wrong_idea: evaluating the extreme factor pair (1, 72) yielding perimeter 13 + 84 + 85 = 182 instead of the minimum perimeter
slots.replacement_rule: the minimum perimeter occurs when sides a and b are closest, corresponding to factor pair (8, 9): a = 20, b = 21, c = 29 -> P = 70
slots.visual_job: render right triangle with inscribed circle of radius 6, showing tangent segments a - r and b - r; avoid unmounted SVGs
slots.check_job: independent check: at a = 20, b = 21, c = 29, Area = (20 * 21)/2 = 210, Perimeter = 20 + 21 + 29 = 70. Area / Perimeter = 210 / 70 = 3. Integer conditions satisfied.

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Multi-discipline problem context requiring synthesis across separate branches
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 activates disparate domain foundations; H2 bridges the domains into a unified equation; preserves W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; complete multi-disciplinary derivation with cross-verification
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific student cross-topic failure or partial synthesis slip

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters or numerical answers in Core 1A text

core1b_reconstruction.model_alternation: Reconstruction must use an alternative verification pathway (e.g. modular residue counting instead of inclusion-exclusion)

core2a_supported_practice.transfer_obligation: Near-transfer item with identical multi-discipline synthesis under modified ratios

core2b_transfer_assessment.transfer_obligation: Far-transfer item extending the synthesis to general integer Heronian triangles
